verdict.rationale: Kit's homepage says it offers apps that connect your creator tools directly to Kit (kit-docs-15), and it runs an App Store where third-party developers publish integrations (kit-docs-18, kit-docs-47). Beyond that, the evidence only shows API building blocks, such as importing purchase data from e-commerce platforms via the API (kit-docs-46), which earn no credit on their own. missing for 10: any named first-party integration with Stripe, Shopify, Segment or a product database; evidence that integrations are maintained by Kit rather than third-party developers; integration setup docs; independent corroboration.
